repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: AT1 拮抗 → 降低出球小動脈阻力 → 減少腎小球高壓 → 抑制腎小球硬化與腎小管纖維化；惡性高血壓腎病正是 AngII 驅動的腎小球損傷模型，機轉高度吻合
腎血管性高血壓依賴 AngII 維持 GFR；AT1 拮抗劑移除此代償機制後，可急速惡化腎功能。雖然 AT1 阻斷可降低血壓，但此類患者的腎功能代償機制將失效

predicted_indications.disease_name: pulmonary hypertension with unclear multifactorial mechanism

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: RAS 在肺血管重塑中有一定角色（AngII 促進肺動脈平滑肌細胞增殖），但缺乏特異性機轉支持；現行 PAH 核准治療（PDE5i、ERA、sPGC 激動劑）效果優於 ARB

predicted_indications.disease_name: pulmonary hypertension owing to lung disease and/or hypoxia

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 低氧→肺血管收縮→RAS 活化→AngII 升高→肺動脈重塑；AT1 拮抗理論上可中斷此路徑，但臨床療效未經驗證，且低氧性 PH 以治療原發肺病為主
目前無已知機轉連結；Braddock syndrome 為發育性遺傳疾病，與 RAS 路徑無直接關聯
AngII 可誘導血管平滑肌收縮（AT1 路徑），理論上 AT1 拮抗可緩解冠狀動脈痙攣；但 Prinzmetal angina 主要由 NO 缺乏與 ROCK 路徑驅動，與 ARB 作用點關聯較弱

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 血管基底膜結構缺陷導致血尿與視網膜血管迂曲；ARB 的 TGF-β 抑制效果理論上可能減緩血管纖維化（類似 Marfan 症候群的 ARB 研究方向），但此為高度推測，無實證

literature.title: Axenfeld-Rieger syndrome: more than meets the eye.
literature.abstract: Axenfeld-Rieger syndrome (ARS) is characterised by typical anterior segment anomalies, with or without systemic features. The discovery of causative genes identified ARS subtypes with distinct phenotypes, but our understanding is incomplete, complicated by the rarity of the condition.

literature.title: Ocular coloboma.
literature.abstract: Ocular coloboma is common malformation which includes a spectrum of anomalies that ranges from iris coloboma to clinical anophthalmos. Coloboma is etiologically heterogeneous. As an isolated defect, it is usually inherited as an autosomal dominant disorder, although autosomal recessive inheritance also occurs. Patients with multiple malformations and coloboma may have a recognized malformation syndrome of unknown etiology, a single gene disorder, or chromosomal abnormality. Prognosis and recurre

literature.title: Neuropathology of holoprosencephaly.
literature.journal: American journal of medical genetics. Part C, Seminars in medical genetics
literature.abstract: Holoprosencephaly (HPE) is a primary disorder of neural induction and patterning of the rostral neural tube resulting in noncleavage of the forebrain with failure to form two separate distinct hemispheres. The spectrum of HPE is very broad and encompasses various neuropathological phenotypes of different severity. literature.title: Optic Nerve Aplasia.
authors: de Faber Jan Tjeerd H N
literature.journal: Journal of neuro-ophthalmology : the official journal of the North American Neuro-Ophthalmology Society
literature.abstract: Optic nerve aplasia (ONA) is a rare ocular anomaly. We report ophthalmologic, systemic, and genetic findings in ONA.

literature.title: [Congenital megalocornea].
literature.abstract: Congenital megalocornea is a bilateral enlargement of the cornea's diameter that can be associated with trabecula and/or iris dysgenesis. This condition predisposes the patient to glaucoma. The physiopathology is poorly understood and may be related to lens induction during embryological development of the anterior of the eye. X-linked genetic transmission is found in 50% of cases, autosomal transmission in 40%, and sporadic transmission in the remaining 10%. Diagnosis is based on a thorough exa

literature.title: Tilted disc syndrome.
literature.journal: Optometry and vision science : official publication of the American Academy of Optometry
literature.abstract: Tilted disc syndrome (TDS) has a varied morphological appearance which can be difficult to differentiate from acquired optic nerve pathology. In addition, there are visual deficits and potential complications associated with this syndrome. Failure to recognize features of the TDS frequently leads to unnecessary medical evaluation or improper examination for possible associated ocular complications.

literature.title: Optic disk abnormalities.
literature.abstract: Ophthalmoscopic abnormalities of the optic disk may signal the presence of acquired intracranial disease; or the disk anomaly may be congenital and only mimic an acquired disk change; or the disk anomaly may be acquired but caused by a purely ocular disease. The abnormal disk may be elevated, excavated, or flat and may be abnormal in color, contour, or size.

literature.journal: The Veterinary clinics of North America. Equine practice
literature.abstract: This discussion provides an idea of the diversity and relative prevalence of certain congenital ocular conditions of horses. Many are not difficult to diagnose, yet curative treatment may be impossible. When dealing with owners of horses affected with unusual anomalies, responsible client service requires veterinarians to provide accurate information and to know where answers to unusual questions can be found. literature.title: [Distichiasis].
literature.journal: Acta medica Croatica : casopis Hravatske akademije medicinskih znanosti
literature.abstract: Distichiasis is a rare congenital or acquired eyelid anomaly in which an accessory row of eyelashes arises from the openings of meibomian glands or near them. The abnormal cilia are posterior to the normal row of cilia and may abrade the eye causing ocular irritation and corneal damage. We describe a 9-year-old Caucasian girl with bilateral and symmetric distichiasis. This condition was treated with lid splitting followed by cryotherapy to the posterior lid lamella. literature.title: [Branchio-oculo-facial syndrome].
literature.journal: Annales de dermatologie et de venereologie
literature.abstract: Branchio-Oculo-Facial Syndrome (BOFS, MIM#113620) is a rare, polymalformational disorder with cutaneous and ocular abnormalities and characteristic facial anomalies. It is an autosomal dominant developmental disorder caused by mutations or deletions in the transcription factor AP-2 alpha gene (TFAP2A, 6p24). We report a new case of atypical BOFS with a unilateral cervical cutaneous defect.

literature.abstract: Congenital craniofacial abnormalities frequently require ophthalmic evaluation and surgical management. Called upon to perform as part of the craniofacial team managing the often severely deformed craniofacial patient, the ophthalmologist must bring a basic knowledge of craniofacial syndromes and developmental anatomy, as well as clinical acumen to help preserve or improve ocular and adnexal function. literature.title: Congenital inner eyelid folds.
literature.abstract: We describe the ocular findings in two infants who were found to have unusual internal eyelid folds during routine probing for nasolacrimal duct (NLD) obstruction.

literature.title: Clinical features and orbital anomalies in Fraser syndrome and a review of management options.
literature.abstract: Fraser syndrome is a rare congenital disorder comprising cryptophthalmos, syndactyly, and many times, urogenital anomalies. Herein, the authors aimed to study and report the clinical features and orbital anomalies in cases diagnosed with Fraser syndrome.

literature.title: Renal coloboma syndrome.
literature.abstract: To characterize the ocular features of renal coloboma syndrome.

literature.title: Ocular manifestations of congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT).
literature.abstract: Congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT) are among the most common birth defects worldwide and a major cause of kidney failure in children. Extra-renal manifestations are also common. This study reviewed diseases associated with the Genomics England CAKUT-associated gene panel for ocular anomalies. In addition, each gene was examined for expression in the human retina and an ocular phenotype in mouse models using the Human Protein Atlas and Mouse Genome Informatics databases,

literature.abstract: The telecanthus-hypospadias (BBB) syndrome is characterised by widely spaced inner ocular canthi and hypospadias of variable degree. Heterozygous females have telecanthus. We have summarised the historical and phenotypic findings of 21 patients in seven previous publications. We have also had the opportunity to evaluate personally 12 families with a total of 18 affected males. literature.title: Ophthalmological Manifestations of Axenfeld-Rieger Syndrome: Current Perspectives.
literature.abstract: Axenfeld-Rieger syndrome (ARS) is a rare congenital disease that is primarily characterized by ocular anterior segment anomalies but is also associated with craniofacial, dental, cardiac, and neurologic abnormalities. Over half of cases are linked with autosomal dominant mutations in either FOXC1 or PITX2, which reflects the molecular role of these genes in regulating neural crest cell contributions to the eye, face, and heart. literature.title: Ablepharon macrostomia syndrome.
literature.abstract: The association of congenital ablepharon with the absence of eyelashes and eyebrows, a wide mouth (macrostomia), and auricular, nasal, genital, and other systemic anomalies has been termed the ablepharon macrostomia syndrome. One such case is reported which illustrates the importance of immediate postnatal ocular management to minimise severe visual loss.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: COL4A1 突變破壞血管基底膜完整性 → 腦小血管出血與白質病變；ARB 的抗纖維化與 TGF-β 抑制可能有間接保護效果，但缺乏任何臨床前或臨床研究支持

literature.title: Prognostic Models for Mortality and Morbidity in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction.
literature.abstract: Accurate risk prediction of morbidity and mortality in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) may help clinicians risk stratify and inform care decisions.

literature.title: Effects of aerobic exercise training and irbesartan on blood pressure and heart rate variability in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
literature.abstract: The present pilot study was undertaken to evaluate the efficacy of an aerobic exercise training (AET) program alone or combined with an antihypertensive agent (irbesartan) to reduce blood pressure (BP) and enhance heart rate variability (HRV) in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease patients.

literature.title: Low Natriuretic Peptide Levels and Outcomes in Patients With Heart Failure and Preserved Ejection Fraction.
literature.abstract: Although some patients with heart failure (HF) with mildly reduced/preserved ejection fraction have low natriuretic peptide levels, there are no large-scale systematic studies of how common these individuals are or what happens to them.

literature.title: Sex differences in clinical characteristics and outcomes in elderly patients with heart failure and preserved ejection fraction: the Irbesartan in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (I-PRESERVE) trial.
literature.abstract: There are few sex-specific outcome data in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.

literature.title: Irbesartan ameliorates chronic mountain sickness in a rat model via the cholesterol metabolism: An iTRAQ -based proteomics analysis.
literature.abstract: To study the effects of irbesartan on pulmonary artery lesions in a rat model with chronic mountain sickness (CMS) and identify the biomarkers involved.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 慢性肺心病（肺源性心臟病）：慢性缺氧 → RAS 活化 → AngII 升高 → 右心室重塑與肺血管收縮；AT1 拮抗可理論上減緩右心纖維化。PMID 34147903 在慢性高山病（低氧）大鼠模型中證實 Irbesartan 可透過膽固醇代謝路徑改善症狀
RAS 參與動脈粥樣硬化與血栓形成機轉；AT1 拮抗可降低血壓、改善血管內皮功能，理論上具中風預防潛力。但此疾病術語已廢棄，建議改以『ischemic stroke prevention』或 ICD-10 對應術語重新查詢
